title: A fork's package takes the codesweep-ai scope
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach installs (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)

evidence.verified: scripts/stage-package.test.mjs passes all 18 of its tests, among them one holding repositoryOf to every form of GitHub remote: https, scp-style, an SSH host alias, and ssh:// with and without one. GitHub CI's `ci` and `npm` passed on 4332859.

resolution: The owner is read from origin with a pattern that takes an SSH host alias, as record-build.sh already did. A fork's package is now staged under the fork's own scope.
details: `scripts/stage-package.mjs` reads the owner from origin with `[@/]github\.com[:/]`, which needs a `:` or `/` right after `github.com`. An SSH host alias such as `git@github.com-fork:forker/ui.git`, which a fork's clones use, does not match. The build then falls back to `codesweep-ai`, so a fork's package is staged under this project's name.
